title: The liquid in the pod
fact: Most e-liquid nicotine is extracted from tobacco waste in India. Harvesters absorb the same nicotine through their skin from wet leaves: 'green tobacco sickness'.

title: The coil you breathe through
fact: The hot coil is where the metal comes from: in 56 users' devices, 57% of aerosol samples exceeded the safe inhalation limit for nickel and 68% for chromium.

title: Vegan leather, real solvent
fact: 'Vegan leather' is polyurethane made with the solvent DMF, which damages workers' livers. In a 2018 survey, 42.6% of workplaces exceeded the health-based safe level.

title: Where it ends up
fact: 6.3 million vapes and pods a week are still binned or wrongly recycled in the UK (2026). Battery fires in bin lorries and waste sites now exceed 1,200 a year.

title: Made in Bao'an
fact: About 90% of the world's e-cigarettes are made in China, mostly in Shenzhen's Bao'an district, where the 2025 minimum wage was 2,520 yuan a month.
